# ReactomePA

```{r reactomepa-echo-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

Earlier in the book you used the [Reactome website](https://reactome.org/) directly to run both ORA and gene set analysis against the Reactome pathway database. [ReactomePA](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ReactomePA.html) is the companion Bioconductor R package, providing scripted, reproducible access to the same pathway database, and integrates directly with the `enrichplot` visualisations used elsewhere in the book.

**Note: this chapter is a placeholder.** The walkthrough for `ReactomePA` is still being written and will be added in a future update. In the meantime, here's how to install it:

```{r install reactomepa, eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("ReactomePA")
```

```{r load reactomepa, eval = FALSE}
library(ReactomePA)
```
